items.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 Responses API 构建可在 Linux 沙箱验证 bug 的 AI 代码审查脚本 / Build an AI Code Reviewer with OpenRouter

sources.title: OpenRouter 教程：用 Responses API 构建可在 Linux 沙箱验证 bug 的 AI 代码审查脚本 / Build an AI Code Reviewer with OpenRouter

sources.title_en: Build an AI Code Reviewer with OpenRouter
sources.title_original: Build an AI Code Reviewer with OpenRouter
sources.summary: Code reviewers that only read a Git diff have to guess whether a change breaks anything, and their fixes come back as prose you apply by hand. This guide builds a Python reviewer on the OpenRouter Responses API that uploads your changed files into a Linux sandbox, runs checks to confirm each bug, and returns validated patches. A review takes one to four minutes and costs $0.015 to $0.045.

sources.summary: 自媒体作者卡兹克分享自己搭建近一年的Agent自动化系统，核心是把任务起点从人身上移开，由事件触发Agent工作。系统分为自动化中台、Agent执行、CI中台和飞书决策四层：中台用rules.json统一管理事件触发和Agent调度，本地MacMini跑Agent任务，自建CI中台完成审查、检查、合并、发布、核实五步，只在删数据、花钱、改方向等关键决策时通过飞书卡片找作者拍板。

sources.title_en: How to Build Your Own Always-On AI Agent
sources.title_original: How to Build Your Own Always-On AI Agent
sources.summary: An always-on AI agent wakes up on a schedule, checks something with tools, and reports or acts without you asking. This tutorial builds one in TypeScript with the OpenRouter Agent SDK that watches Hacker News, remembers what it has seen across restarts, stops any run at five cents, and waits for your approval before it posts.
